sn56.19:1.1: “‘This is the noble truth of suffering’: such has been made known by me.
sn56.19:1.2: In this statement, ‘This is the noble truth of suffering,’ there are innumerable nuances, innumerable details, innumerable implications.
sn56.19:1.4: “‘This is the noble truth of the origin of suffering’ …
sn56.19:1.5: ‘This is the noble truth of the cessation of suffering’ …
sn56.19:1.6: ‘This is the noble truth of the way leading to the cessation of suffering’: such has been made known by me.
sn56.19:1.7: In this statement, ‘This is the noble truth of the way leading to the cessation of suffering,’ there are innumerable nuances, innumerable details, innumerable implications.
sn56.19:2.1: “Therefore, bhikkhus, an exertion should be made to understand: ‘This is suffering.’… An exertion should be made to understand: ‘This is the way leading to the cessation of suffering.’”
